name: Allonic Hand MK2
summary: A biomimetic tendon-driven hand made as one braided composite piece by the Budapest startup's '3D Tissue Braiding' process: tendons, pulley paths and structure are produced in a single automated run, with no screws, cables or assembled joints. It is a technology demonstrator for weaving whole robot bodies. Allonic has published no official DoF, weight or payload figures; the 15 DoF and 450 g in directory listings are unverified.
